claim_boundaries.source_claim: Discipleship requires an available follower of at least level 10 who is not already a disciple, plus ritual availability/affordability. The ceremony explicitly grants the trait/status and increments the created count; reaching the level alone is not this promotion.
claim_boundaries.adaptation_boundary: Earned competence and separately performed appointment are different facts. The paid fitting service, consent, office ending and local prices are original design, not source formulas.

claim_boundaries.source_claim: Productivity uses a level contribution clamped at10 and then trait, relationship, institution and season modifiers. Missionary success uses its own level tiers; demon effectiveness separately clamps level at10 plus a necklace bonus. The productivity winter-body conditional has a negative false branch even if the trait is absent.
claim_boundaries.adaptation_boundary: Different consumers use their own bounded competence rules. No source level, multiplier, trait, season, missionary or demon formula is ported.

claim_boundaries.source_claim: Follower data declares keyed identity/location/task destination/home, mission commitments, rewards, parentage, inventory, traits, funeral history and pair relationships. Loaded and simulated follower objects share the brain/data model; visible entity replacement is not a new person. These are selected static definitions, not a save roundtrip audit.
claim_boundaries.adaptation_boundary: Loaded and simulated representations retain the same underlying follower information. This slice reuses the actual existing Eda actor; selected definitions are not an observed source save roundtrip.

claim_boundaries.source_claim: Reconsideration releases old reservations, resolves personal priorities, tries to keep an existing unique task, then claims eligible tasks by role/priority category. The shared location scheduler can displace lower-priority allocations and then settles pending choices. The named level-requirement helper currently returns true.
claim_boundaries.adaptation_boundary: Task eligibility, willingness, priority and reservation are distinct. This slice reuses YAIR actor/site reservations; it does not port the source scheduler or its unconditional level helper.

adaptation.name: Eda’s fitting assessor agreement
adaptation.competence: Actual player observe_alignment and learn completions; Eda retained demonstration and her existing trained active grain_matching source, faculty and power.
adaptation.appointment: Explicit willing co-located one-minute appointment; office fact belongs to Eda.
adaptation.inspection: 1 native player coin + 1 Eda stamina + 2 played minutes; reserve and return 1 owned Matched repair stave and Eda’s actual owned fine or fineDull guide, unchanged.
adaptation.approval: One use approval of the fungible Matched repair stave class; mutually exclusive static guide routes with distinct retained knowledge keys. No per-copy identity or provenance.
adaptation.order: One finite approved order reserves one player-owned matched stave and three existing Eda coins; one-minute handover is an original provisional timing; completion transfers that native item to Eda and pays three native player coins, consuming approval once.
adaptation.termination: Explicit ending removes future office access while retaining competence, appointment and delivered history; no active fitting source needed to end.
adaptation.boundary: Source-inspired original adaptation. No copied source code/prose/media, source ritual, productivity formula, new title/actor/currency engine or top-level save domain.
